headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Digital Bank Collapse Crisis
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned amid a banking crisis following the collapse of digital lender Ueno, which held hundreds of millions in public funds and left 3 million customers without account access.
why: Political instability and major banking failures in emerging markets undermine investor confidence, affect sovereign debt risk premiums, and disrupt domestic financial systems.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: A presidential resignation alongside a major domestic banking collapse creates severe political and financial disruption.
